diagnosed: One real, reproducible mechanical breakage, independently re-confirmed again today with fresh recurrences; its only correct fix lives entirely in a hook-protected path (.github/workflows/research-agent.yml), so no PR is possible from an unattended CI agent. The research ESCALATION fast-lane remains 100% broken. Scout/coverage-critic request a deep escalation via scripts/escalate-research.js -> `gh workflow run research-agent.yml -f tier=deep` using the job GITHUB_TOKEN, so the dispatched run's actor is github-actions[bot]. anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 resolves to a newer action build (logs show __anthropics_claude-code-action_2/_3) that gates non-human actors and rejects bot actors unless listed in allowed_bots; no step in research-agent.yml sets it (default empty = allow no bots). Every escalated research run therefore dies at its claude-code-action step with 'Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use * to allow all bots.' Confirmed firsthand from the failed-run log of the NEWEST occurrence: workflow_dispatch run 45628931732 (2026-11-25T13:57Z) failed BOTH the Fable 5 'deep, preferred' step (continue-on-error, so it did not fail the job) AND the Opus 4.8 'deep fallback' step (no continue-on-error, so the job failed) with that exact error — the entire deep tier is dead on escalation. The run-list pattern is unambiguous across the last 20 research runs: every `schedule` run carries a human actor and succeeds (e.g. 2026-11-25T14:22Z run 45633268168, 2026-11-25T00:43Z run 45520302786), every `workflow_dispatch` (bot) run fails (45628931732 2026-11-25T13:57Z, 45522955676 2026-11-25T01:04Z, 45416152473 2026-11-24T14:37Z, 45216865200 + 45191186907 2026-11-23, 45028315716 + 45021975076 2026-11-22, 44947500043 2026-11-21 ...). The `gh workflow run` dispatch itself returns success, so escalate-research.js reports success, masking the failure except as red research runs. ALREADY TRACKED by OPEN issue #430 ('Research escalation fast-lane is 100% broken (bot actor rejected by claude-code-action)', still OPEN).

OWNER FIX NEEDED (protected .github/workflows/research-agent.yml) — ALREADY TRACKED by OPEN issue #430: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` to the with: block of the two deep-tier claude-code-action@v1 steps (Fable 5 'deep, preferred' and Opus 4.8 'deep fallback'). Verified against the action source src/github/validation/actor.ts: the matcher lowercases and strips a trailing [bot], so `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` correctly matches the github-actions[bot] actor. Scope to the trusted first-party Actions bot; do NOT use `*` on this public repo. NEW CAVEAT found this run (NOT in #430's original fix): per the action's docs/security.md, setting allowed_bots moves the token OUT of .git/config into a credential helper that reads GH_TOKEN — the deep steps' in-prompt `git push` relies on the checkout@v5-persisted .git/config extraheader, so `github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` must ALSO be added to the two deep steps or the push will lose its credentials. Leave the standard scheduled step untouched (it works today; adding allowed_bots there would needlessly change its credential path).

Could NOT author the fix: this is the unattended Self-repair CI agent (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true/CI=true), so the CI-only scripts/hooks/protect-automation.js PreToolUse hook fires and BLOCKS any Edit/Write/Bash mutation of .github/workflows/** ('A human must author changes to these files'). Re-confirmed this run: on a self-repair/ branch the Edit adding allowed_bots+github_token to research-agent.yml was blocked by the hook (exit 2); branch deleted, working tree clean. By design an unattended CI agent cannot author protected-path (.github/workflows/**) changes — the hook is a hard safety invariant and was NOT circumvented (no env-var/API/indirect-write workaround attempted) — so no PR is possible and the fix must be applied by a human.

No non-protected fix exists: the breakage is the bot-actor gate on the dispatched run. Any GITHUB_TOKEN-authenticated `gh workflow run`/repository_dispatch produces a Bot actor regardless of event, so changing escalate-research.js cannot make the dispatch a human actor without a new PAT secret + workflow wiring (itself a protected change). The allowed_bots (+github_token) addition to the two deep steps is the correct, minimal fix.

This run DID add one comment to OPEN issue #430 (issuecomment-7169734719) — justified because it carries genuinely NEW technical content absent from the issue's original fix: (a) the github_token/credential-helper caveat above, and (b) confirmation from the action source that `github-actions` matches the `[bot]`-suffixed actor. This is not the 'a comment every run is noise' case the prior run rightly avoided; it is a one-time correction that stops a human applying the fix verbatim from hitting a surprise push failure. No duplicate issue opened. The git history of this log remains the recurrence/confirmation timeline (newest confirmed occurrence: run 45628931732, 2026-11-25T13:57Z).
